title: R100-SL grouped dwelling: all R-Codes provisions apply subject to the Table 2.10a modifications
text: Housing on lots less than 100m2 - applies to single houses and grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL only. C2.10.1 Grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL are to comply with the following: ii. all provisions of the R-Codes to apply, subject to the modifications in Table 2.10a.

replaces.note: 85% site cover and ceiling height rows removed; balcony/roof terrace POS alternative removed; cross-references now C3.4.5 and C3.6.5

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Not evaluated here: Table 2.10a (p26) modifies values owned by elements 1.1, 1.2, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 3.6, 3.9 and 3.10; those parts carry R100-SL variants. Footnote 1: where development abuts a property not coded R100-SL, the modified provisions do not apply. Register ch3-040: ToC says 'no modifications made', which is inaccurate.

verified.note: Ambiguous on the page: the element sub-heading (p25) reads 'Housing on lots less than 100m2 - applies to single houses and grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL only', while C2.10.1 names only the R100-SL coding; whether an R100-SL lot of 100m2 or more is caught is not stated.
